In this temporary position, you will play a key role in coordinating outbound logistics activities across Europe and ensuring timely and accurate deliveries to customers. This is an excellent opportunity for a logistics professional who enjoys working in a dynamic international environment and has experience with ERP systems, preferably Oracle.  Wie zoeken we? We are looking for a candidate who has: - A Bachelor's degree (HBO level) in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field. - At least 3-4 years of experience in a similar logistics or supply chain position. - Knowledge of ERP systems, preferably Oracle. - Experience working in an international business environment. - Strong organizational and coordination skills. - Excellent communication skills and a proactive attitude. - A hands-on approach and the ability to work independently. - Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. - Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.  Wat bieden wij je? What we offer: - A salary between €3,300 and €3,500 gross per month, depending on experience. - Day shifts from Monday to Thursday: 08:30 - 17:00, and Friday: 08:30 - 16:00. - Temporary assignment of approximately 3 months, with the possibility of extension. - The opportunity to work in an international and fast-paced environment. Functieomschrijving As a Logistics Outbound Specialist, you will be responsible for coordinating and monitoring outbound logistics processes from order fulfillment to customer delivery.

Broekman Logistics is an international logistics service provider with over 60 years of experience in supply chain solutions. From various locations in the Netherlands and abroad, they provide storage, distribution, assembly, and transportation services for clients across multiple industries. The Born location is modern, easily accessible, and plays a key role in the logistics process for international clients. At Broekman Logistics, teamwork, reliability, and efficiency are core values. To support continued growth, we are looking for Allround Logistics Employees to join the team in a long-term position. Wie zoeken we? We’re looking for motivated individuals who: Have affinity with or experience in logistics Live near Born and are available full-time Are physically fit and enjoy hands-on work Speak English Are able to provide a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG) Wat bieden wij je? competitive hourly wage between €16,12 and €17,- Travel allowance of €0.23 per km A stable, long-term position with day shifts only A modern and professional logistics environment A friendly, international work atmosphere Varied workdays and opportunities for growth Option to obtain your forklift/reach truck certificate through us Would you like to take the next step in your logistics career at Broekman Logistics in Born? Apply directly via the button we’ll be in touch shortly to discuss the possibilities. Functieomschrijving As an Allround Logistics Employee, you will play a vital role in the day-to-day logistics operations. Depending on your experience and preferences, your responsibilities will include one or both of the following areas: General warehouse tasks: Picking and packing orders Unpacking and preparing goods for shipment Inventory control and stock checks Maintaining a clean and organized work environment Optional forklift/reach truck tasks (a plus, not a must): Loading and unloading trucks Internal transport of pallets Operating a forklift or reach truck (experience andcertificate are not required but considered a plus) You’ll work in shifts between 06:00 and 18:00, with no night shifts.

MSD Animal Health is a leading global manufacturer of animal health products. The company develops, produces, and packages pharmaceuticals and vaccines for companion animals as well as livestock. jobs.description: Are you a passionate culinary professional who enjoys working in a dynamic kitchen environment? As a Chef de Partie, you will be part of our dedicated kitchen team, creating high-quality dishes and contributing to memorable dining experiences for our guests. This role is ideal for a motivated chef who values teamwork, craftsmanship, and delivering consistent culinary excellence in a professional hospitality setting.Your responsibilities include:• Preparing and presenting dishes according to our quality standards.• Managing your own section within the kitchen and ensuring efficient workflow during service.• Supporting the preparation and execution of lunch, dinner, and banqueting services.• Ensuring consistency in taste, presentation, and portion control.• Working closely with the Chef kok and fellow kitchen colleagues to maintain smooth communication and teamwork.• Monitoring stock levels, minimizing waste, and handling ingredients responsibly.• Ensuring compliance with food safety, hygiene standards, and HACCP regulations.• Supporting and guiding junior kitchen colleagues when needed.• Contributing ideas and improvements to enhance our dishes and kitchen operations.Who are we looking for?• Previous experience as a Chef de Partie, Kok or a similar kitchen position.• Experience working in a hotel, restaurant, or high-quality hospitality environment.• Good knowledge of cooking techniques, food preparation, and kitchen procedures.• A passion for creating high-quality dishes and delivering consistent results.• Strong organizational skills and the ability to work efficiently during busy service periods.• A positive attitude, team-oriented mindset, and willingness to support colleagues.• Knowledge of HACCP and food safety regulations.• Ability to communicate effectively in English; Dutch is an advantage. Looking for a job where you can grow, work with modern technology, and make a real difference every day? Join DHL Supply Chain in Wijchen/Nijmegen and become part of a team that keeps essential products moving around the world. Wie zoeken we? You don’t need years of experience, we’re looking for the right attitude. You speak Dutch or English You’re motivated and enjoy practical, hands-on work You’re accurate and responsible You’re willing to learn and develop yourself You’re able to provide a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG) You’re comfortable working in a dynamic logistics environment Wat bieden wij je? At DHL, you’ll get more than just a job. You’ll have the opportunity to develop yourself while working for one of the world’s leading logistics companies. Monthly salary of €2630,88 Full-time or part-time working options Extra bonuses for overtime and evening shifts from 18:00 onwards 8.33% holiday allowance Travel allowance of up to €9.30 per day Opportunities to obtain valuable logistics certifications Pension accrual after 8 working weeks Opportunities for career development and internal growth Possibility of a permanent contract Functieomschrijving At DHL, you’re not just another employee. You’ll work in a modern, clean, and high-tech logistics environment where teamwork, quality, and accuracy are key. You’ll handle a wide range of products, including important pharmaceutical goods. Your work helps ensure that essential and sometimes life-saving products reach the people who need them, making your contribution truly meaningful. Your role as a Logistics Operator As a Logistics Operator, you make sure customer orders are processed accurately and ready to leave the warehouse on time. Your day is varied, active, and hands-on. Your responsibilities include: Picking and preparing customer orders for shipment Checking, counting, and managing inventory Printing labels and preparingpackages Processing returns accurately Packing shipments and preparing them for transport Following DHL’s quality, safety, and hygiene procedures You don’t need previous logistics experience. We’ll teach you everything you need to know. Because you’ll be working with pharmaceutical products, you’ll receive thorough training and guidance from day one. Grow with DHL At DHL, your development matters. Once you’ve mastered your role, there are opportunities to expand your skills and take additional training or certifications, such as: EPT Forklift Reach truck OPT And if you’re ambitious, there are opportunities to grow into positions with more responsibility, such as Team Leader.
